name: AuthLayout
description: Mortar auth page shell for sign-in, sign-up, password reset, verification and two-factor screens: logo, h1, description, the form and a footer link, centred, on a card or split beside an image or testimonial.

contract.usage: Import { AuthLayout } from @tony-ui/mortar. Use it as the whole page for each auth step, outside AppShell and MarketingHeader. It renders the page's main landmark and h1. Put a <form> directly in children (fields stack, direct Button children fill the width), with ProviderButtons and a labelled Divider where providers apply, and the switch link ("Don't have an account? Sign up") in footer. Fields: Input type="email" autoComplete="email" (or autoComplete="username"), PasswordInput, CodeInput, Input autoComplete="name". For a section inside another page, use SignInPanel. See docs/auth-flows.md for every step.
contract.avoid: Do not nest it in another shell or page main, add a second h1, or hide password rules and errors.
contract.accessibility: main is named by the heading. On narrow screens the split layout puts text asides after the form and hides a lone image or video.
